title: nauclea ovalifolia
intro: Nauclea ovalifolia, commonly known as Quinine Tree or Nauclea, is a plant species in the family Rubiaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly for its use in treating fever and malaria due to its active compound quinine. The health benefits of Nauclea ovalifolia include reducing inflammation and relieving symptoms of fever, while its therapeutic actions include acting as an anti-inflammatory, antimalarial, and antimicrobial agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include quinine, kaempferol, and other flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
